patch_list: Removes Better Place's portrait orientation lock so the app can rotate to landscape.
Strips the capture attribute and forces the native chooser to use gallery-only file inputs.
Embeds and runs the Charity Framework plugin loader on bplace.art pages (mobile GM shim + native fetch bridge).
Prevents the file picker from requesting CAMERA permission or forcing camera capture.
